item.title: 3 Wishes (plus a Poem) for You
item.description: Dear Friends,As we near the middle of December, time passes quicker than we anticipate. Still, the world’s problems grow deeper. item.title: Christmas in Germany
item.description: Christmas--the most magical time of the year! We spent it with family in Saxony, in our quiet, hilltop village. It overlooks the lights of Dresden, a charming city known for its historical Christmas markets. item.title: Today, The Sky is Weeping (A Poem)
item.description: There was a time when I told my children That war was long agoBut today, death tolls give way,Staining February snow.Today, the sky is weepingTorrents flood our feeds and farmsTerrors rage on this splattered pageAnd fathers take up arms. item.title: Trail to Tranquilty: South Tyrol
item.description: When we travel, I usually have the good seat: the passenger one. It’s John, my husband, who drives. He skillfully navigates hairpin curves along narrow mountain trails, avoiding oncoming cyclists on one side, and walls of snow or sleet on the other. I get to settle snugly in the seatbelt, eyes transfixed on the tranquil views above. item.title: Welcoming September
item.description: Dear Friends, As summer comes to a close, and gentle raindrops run down my attic window, I’m finally stopping to pause.Thinking of three months spent, 22 cities crossed, and the people we met. New friends, old family members; colleagues, and clients.Always, there were interactions, relationships, and serendipitous moments that made our family travels memorable.I’m also thinking about difficult conversations.
